data.headline: Maui County agenda flags acquisition of MLP water assets

claims.text: A Maui County committee agenda listed an item on acquiring MLP’s water infrastructure assets in West Maui and Upcountry.

citation.quote: ACQUISITION OF MAUI LAND & PINEAPPLE COMPANY, INC.’S WATER INFRASTRUCTURE ASSETS IN WEST MAUI AND UPCOUNTRY  (DRIP-9(12))

claims.text: The company agreed to pay 90% of capital costs for filtration systems in future wells if DBCP exceeds specified levels.

citation.quote: Pursuant to a 1999 settlement agreement with the County of Maui, the Company and several chemical manufacturers agreed to pay for 90% of capital costs to install filtration systems in any future water wells if the presence of a nematicide, commonly known as DBCP, exceeds specified levels

claims.text: The company paid approximately $23,000 for filtration and maintenance reimbursement costs in 2025 and 2024.

citation.quote: The Company paid approximately $23,000 for the reimbursement of filtration and maintenance costs during each of the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.

claims.text: MLP’s Kapalua Makai project has State and County entitlements for up to 573 residences, 349 hotel units, and new commercial or resort amenities.

citation.quote: The land has State and County land use entitlements to deliver up to 573 residences, 349 hotel units, and new commercial and/or resort amenities.
